# Robotics Basics

Two engines, one set of ideas. **[MuJoCo](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/)** is the academic default (`mjModel` / `mjData`). **[Motrix](https://motrixsim.readthedocs.io/en/latest/)** (`motrixsim`) loads the same [MJCF / URDF](references.qmd#robotics-assets) into `SceneModel` / `SceneData` and adds a named-object API plus a viewer.

Two maps show up constantly:

- **Forward kinematics (FK):** joint coordinates → body and site poses. “Where is the gripper if the joints are `q`?”
- **Inverse kinematics (IK):** a desired pose → joint coordinates (or a joint step `dq`). “What `q` puts the gripper there?”

Every subsection below shows the concept once, then the two APIs side by side on the **AgileX Piper** Menagerie scene. Start with:

```bash
bash scripts/fetch_menagerie_assets.sh
uv sync --extra sim
uv run python scripts/mujoco_robot_demo.py
uv run python scripts/motrix_robot_demo.py
```

[Two simulators](two-simulators.qmd#two-simulators) walks the shared model/data workflow; [Isaac Lab](two-simulators.qmd#isaac-lab) is documented for the same concepts at scale (no Isaac scripts in this repo).
